scope: Surrogates of the full-brain STD simulator, not competing living-fly mechanisms
fit_rows: Old M1, T=500 ms, train phase only: 5 seeds x 12 pulses
retrospective_rows: Other old M1 rows; these results were seen previously, not a blind test
fit_loss: sum of squared count residuals, deterministic multistart nonnegative least_squares
selection: Maximum RMSE disagreement across prospective seeds and train/recovery windows; second selected condition must differ in rate or pulse duration

evaluation.primary: MAE and RMSE in raw aBN1 spike counts

input_interface: Greedy skip of an injected event immediately after a previously accepted event; accepted injections emit sensory spikes one tick later. Validated against all 5 old static sensory-event sequences before fitting. Must be checked again on new full-brain data.
